title: Recorded browser errors
responsibility: Display recorded console errors and uncaught exceptions alongside their expectations and test-attempt context.

inputs.name: BrowserErrors.diagnostics
inputs.description: Optional recorded test-attempt diagnostics. Missing or empty arrays render nothing; each supplied attempt may contain observations, expectations or both.

outputs.name: BrowserErrors
outputs.description: Expandable Browser errors group with the total classified row count, test/file/project or browser identity and retry number. Rows show expected, unexpected or missing-expected status, message, expectation reason and available source/page/stack as escaped text. Source line and column display one-based coordinates. A supplied attempt with no rows still appears under a zero-entry summary.
